name: Verify user can close and reopen chat without losing context
precondition: User logged in, chat open with messages

steps.description: Send a message to the AI assistant
steps.expectedResult: Message is sent and response is received

steps.description: Minimize or close the chat panel
Reopen the chat panel by clicking the icon
Verify previous messages are still visible
steps.expectedResult: All previous messages and responses are still displayed in the conversation
